_readme: Vertical (TikTok) cut. 'segments' and 'cues' are SOURCE seconds on the landscape video timeline (the clock of ../audio/voiceover.wav, assets/presenter.webm and assets/prompter-live.mp4; see ../RETIME.md). Segments are snapped to whole frames and played back to back. Edit, then run: node build.mjs

segments._: You read your notes ... See? It jumped ahead with me.
Write your script ... record yourself with one click.
It all runs locally ... when you share your screen.
NotchPrompter. Look people in the eye. Now on the Mac App Store.

cues._note: skippedLine and jump are read from the screen footage (same as ../timings.json); speech cues from silencedetect on ../audio/voiceover.wav
